title: Infant formula, Similac Isomil Soy, powder, made with bottled water

content.title: About
content.content: Similac Isomil Soy is a ready‑to‑feed infant formula based on soy protein, designed for babies who are lactose‑intolerant or have a cow‑milk protein sensitivity. The powder is mixed with bottled water, ensuring a consistent composition and convenient preparation.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Developed by Abbott, a leading global manufacturer of pediatric nutrition.
Enriched with DHA and ARA, fatty acids important for brain and eye development.
Suitable for infants from birth up to 12 months who require soy‑based nutrition.
One container provides multiple daily servings when prepared according to instructions.
The formula is gluten‑free and contains no artificial colors.

items.title: Source of plant protein
items.content: Soy protein supplies all essential amino acids needed for growth and development.

items.title: Supports immunity
items.content: Includes prebiotics and B‑vitamins that promote a healthy gut microbiome.

items.title: Contains DHA and ARA
items.content: These long‑chain fatty acids aid neural and visual system maturation.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: Soy protein is often better tolerated by infants with cow‑milk sensitivity.

items.title: Lactose‑free
items.content: Ideal for babies with lactase deficiency.

items.title: Soy allergy
items.content: Some infants may develop an allergic reaction to soy proteins.

items.title: Not a substitute for breast milk
items.content: The formula is intended as a supplement or replacement only when breastfeeding is not possible.

items.title: Correct reconstitution required
items.content: Improper water‑to‑powder ratio can lead to dehydration or over‑nutrition.

items.title: Storage after opening
items.content: Keep the opened container in a dry place and use within the stated period.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Use clean bottled water warmed to 37 °C. Add the measured amount of powder, mix thoroughly until smooth. Prepared formula should be used within 1 hour.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, use within 30 days. Do not keep prepared formula at room temperature for more than 1 hour.
